title: Post-Cut-Off Increases: Commitment Cut — Group Room Blocks
content:
**Rider.** The commitment share of a Group Room Blocks increase is lowered by a post-cut-off cut that follows when the increase is implemented, measured in calendar days after the block's cut-off date:

- implemented **more than 3** calendar days after the cut-off date: a cut of **20** percentage points;
- implemented **at least 1 but no more than 3** calendar days after the cut-off date: a cut of **10** percentage points;
- implemented on or before the cut-off date: no cut.

### On the calendar (hypothetical cut-off date)

| Increase implemented | Cut |
|---|---|
| 5 days before the cut-off date | none |
| on the cut-off date | none |
| 1 day after the cut-off date | 10 points |
| 3 days after the cut-off date | 10 points |
| 4 days after the cut-off date | 20 points |
| 30 days after the cut-off date | 20 points |
